description: Call this before paying a specific API URL you were given or found elsewhere, to see whether it can be trusted: Hagglyai's reliability score and recent check history, its price per call, how many paying users it has, and any warnings (for example a payment wallet that does not match the seller). It never calls the URL. Hagglyai API documentation: https://hagglyai.com/openapi.json
